questions.q: Why can't the Excel Online (Business) connector see data in a well-organized but plain cell range?
options: The connector only supports .xls files, not .xlsx
Every action requires selecting a formal Excel Table object, which a plain range is not, even if it looks structured
Plain ranges can only hold text, not numbers
The file must be stored locally, never in OneDrive or SharePoint
questions.explain: Every action asks you to pick a Table from a dropdown. If the range was never converted to a real Excel Table (via Insert > Table), the connector's actions simply can't reference it.

questions.q: What do Get a row, Update a row, and Delete a row all have in common?
options: They all require a key column and key value to identify which single row to act on
They all create a new worksheet automatically
They can only be used with numeric columns
They require the Workflows app to be installed
questions.explain: All three actions locate a row using a key column and a matching key value. If more than one row matches, only the first match is affected.

questions.q: By default, what is the maximum number of rows List rows present in a table returns?
options: 256, unless pagination is turned on in the action's settings
There is no limit by default
questions.explain: List rows present in a table returns up to 256 rows by default. Getting more requires explicitly turning on pagination in the action's settings.

questions.q: A flow needs to filter an Excel table on a numeric 'greater than' comparison, which List rows present in a table's own Filter Query doesn't support. What's the real workaround?
options: It's impossible to filter on numbers in Power Automate
List all rows first, then apply a Filter array action to the results for the richer condition
Convert the Excel file to a SharePoint list first
Use five separate List rows actions, one per possible value
questions.explain: The connector's Filter Query only supports basic OData operators (eq, ne, contains, startswith, endswith). For anything richer, like numeric comparisons, you list all rows and then filter with a separate Filter array action.

questions.q: In the Castlebridge Logistics damaged-freight example, what does Add a row into a table do?
options: It deletes resolved entries from the log automatically
It appends a new row — shipment ID, carrier, damage description, date — matched to the table's existing columns
It creates a brand-new Excel Table every time it runs
It sends an email notification instead of writing to the workbook
questions.explain: Add a row into a table appends a new row of data into the specified Excel Table, with values matched to the table's existing column structure.
